description:
Compare Weirdgloop daily guide-price snapshots for an RS3 item set. Use get_item_details for item records, estimate_flip for profit, or get_price_series for history.

- names selects the first match for each name. Use lookup_item if uncertain; aliases resolving to one ID remain separate rows.
- itemIds bypasses name lookup. Supply a JSON array such as [4151,536], not comma-separated text.

Unresolved items produce ordered error rows, even if all are unresolved. Volume/timestamps may be absent; items can have different snapshot dates.

Reads are uncached, need no credentials and do not provide live offers. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

itemIds.description: Grand Exchange item IDs to compare (1-10). Provide names or itemIds, not both.

names.description: Item names to compare (1-10). Provide names or itemIds, not both.

name: compare_item_prices

error.description: Present when this row could not be resolved

query.description: Name or id that was requested

title: Compare Daily Price Snapshots
